title: Modeling of an ODE-constrained optimization problem describing tumor dynamics, and numerical approximation via sequential physics-informed neural networks
summary: In this paper, we study an optimal control problem related to an ODE model of glioblastoma growth influenced by the oxygen. The model considers a couple of controls describing the chemotherapy and antiangiogenic therapies. The cost functional aims to reduce the tumor growth, bring the oxygen concentration close to a desired value, and penalize the use of therapies. We solve the optimal control problem, proving the existence of a global optimal control and deriving first-order necessary optimality conditions through the Pontryagin Minimum Principle.
